_what: Corpus overlap for the 15 Han et al. ionizable lipids, measured three ways
IL_name_token_sweep_note: A NAME SWEEP, NOT AN IDENTITY CLAIM. Each hit is adjudicated by the structure columns beside it. Search is digit-boundary, not ^-anchored, so names such as 'A200_C12' and '114-L1-C12' are both reached.

superset_sweep_2hydroxyalkyl_amine.LABEL: SUPERSET - NOT an identity match
superset_sweep_2hydroxyalkyl_amine.why_superset: This SMARTS matches ANY tertiary-amine 2-hydroxyalkyl motif, including lipidoids from unrelated libraries and any lipid that merely happens to carry an N-CH2-CH(OH)-CH2 fragment. It is reported as an upper bound on how much of the corpus is CHEMICALLY NEARBY, and must not be read as overlap.

name_vs_structure_split_note: KL_2010 is Love et al. PNAS 2010, the ORIGINAL epoxide-amine lipidoid library that this paper's amine numbering comes from. Its 114C12 and 114C14 match our C12-114 and C14-114 on the FULL InChIKey, which independently confirms the cross-lab amine catalogue (F-055). Its 200C8/200C10/200C12/200C14 do NOT match our C*-200 and are not even the same size class. This is recorded as a CONTRADICTION IN data/, not as a doubt about our structure: AC_2025 (498 rows) and JW_2024 both carry our exact C12-200 InChIKey, and our MW is reproduced by the paper's own stoichiometry. We do not edit data/. See 08_contradictions.csv.
